{{Top|leg}}
'''Nephs''' were huge, docile flying beasts native to [[Dalos IV]]. They flew by generating [[Hydrogen/Legends|hydrogen]] from water vapor and storing the gas in internal sacs. Increasing or decreasing the amount of gas stored allowed the neph to change its altitude. They had a long rudder-like tail and flat rubbery wings that they used to maneuver.

Nephs feed on [[Insect/Legends|bugs]] and pollen in the [[Atmosphere/Legends|atmosphere]]. Young nephs could carry a single rider, but mature ones could transport up to twenty people in gondolas strapped to the underside of the creature.

Immature nephs were used in the [[trophy chase]], a sporting event popular on Dalos IV.
